title: Bertha's return and Louis Armstrong meeting her at Dreamland
summary: Sorting out Bertha Gonsoulin's comings and goings, and how Louis, newly in town with Oliver, met Lil at Dreamland.

blocks.x: Yeah, she came back to Chicago with the band.
She did come back with them.
She came back from Los Angeles with them. Yes. I think they worked at the Garden. Yes, they worked at the Garden when they came back and I was still at the Dreamland. I was never straight
whether she really played. Yes, she came back.

No, we hadn't made the records yet. Now, this is 22. This is 22. So, she went back to Los Angeles. When she went back to Los Angeles, I joined Lenore. Well, now, let's see. Louis came to join Oliver while I was still at Dreamland because the first night he was in town, Oliver brought him over to Dreamland to meet me.
It was not at the Royal Garden then, it was at the Dreamland.
